entry.title: UniFi Access Point 7.0.92
entry.summary:
Improvements
Improved 2.4 GHz band connectivity and stability. Improved Packet Capture feature. Improved TX Retries reporting. Improved connectivity at low signal levels. Improved stability.
Bugfixes
Fixed various mobile device 6 GHz connectivity issues. Fixed incorrectly reported disconnect events during client roam. Fixed AP going offline when the Network application is unreachable for some time.
Additional information Please note that this firmware is not available for U7 Pro Max. We are actively working on adapting recent improvements for the U7 Pro Max and anticipate its release at a later date.
Update your devices by changing the Device Firmware Release Channel in the UniFi Network application to Official. If you wish to go back to the Official release after the upgrade, change the release channel back to Official.
If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:
AP model(s) Previous AP release version UniFi Network application version Please post a support file as well

entry.title: UniFi Access Point 7.0.85
entry.summary:
Overview * This release is the initial release for the E7. E7 is an enterprise-grade indoor access point delivering 10-stream Wi-Fi 7 performance for unmatched wireless connectivity. Equipped with two Ethernet ports—10GbE and 1GbE—it ensures power and data redundancy, providing increased reliability for critical operations. The E7 features a dedicated scanning radio, enabling real-time spectrum analysis.
